correctness.rationale: For every integer \(q\ge3\): the group-equivariant collapse reduces the relative pair \((\mathcal N[K_q\square K_q],A)\) to two triangles per off-row/off-column edge, giving an exactly surjective relative degree-two boundary, and \(H_1(A)\) as \(U\otimes U\). Every rectangular \(K_{q,q}\) nerve cycle is filled; the exact sequence thus identifies the second homology as the kernel. Fixed relative generators contribute + for pure coordinate permutations and - for interchanging permutations, with counts \(2\binom{f(\sigma)}2\binom{f(\tau)}2+2t(\sigma)t(\tau)\) and \(f(\sigma\tau)(f(\sigma\tau)-1)\). Subtracting the first-homology traces gives the two claimed character identities and all other reduced homology vanishes. The independent exhaustive checker compares reduced signed fixed-face Lefschetz traces against both polynomials for all 1232 group elements at \(q=2,3,4\) (VERIFY_OK). This test is a finite check, not the source of the infinite proof.
